text: The Disaster and Climate Resilience Improvement Project (DCRIP) is a World Bank-financed initiative aimed at reducing Pakistan's vulnerability to flooding and climate variability. The project focuses on restoring resilient flood protection infrastructure and strengthening government capacity for disaster risk management and climate variability. It aligns with Pakistan's disaster risk management framework and global climate adaptation priorities.
